bowl_config.observability_stack: Jaeger (OTLP HTTP/gRPC :4317, sample_ratio=0.10) + Prometheus (2s dual-node scrape) + Loki + Alloy + Grafana + bowl stats + pprof
bowl_config.storage_engine: StoreActor per disk (Pebble + 128 MiB 共享缓存 + 双缓冲 MPSC Group Commit + 16B BlobRef + WriteRequest 池化零分配解码)
bowl_config.blob_layout: packs/<pack_id_hex16>.pack (64 MiB Append-Only Pack + 256 KiB 块网格 + 尾块分片热缓存 + AppendBlocks 零冗余拷贝 + ExtendTail)
bowl_config.wal_sync_mode: pebble.NoSync Group Commit + Fsync/FsyncDir 双层并行落盘屏障 (fdatasync + LogData)
bowl_config.concurrency_model: 单盘独立 StoreActor 串行 Phase A 内存校验 + WriterEpoch 世代号栅栏 + 无锁并发 Read
